in_hebrew.name: כירסטין
in_hebrew.long_meaning: A feminine name derived from the Old Norse 'kjötr' meaning 'pure, clear' and 'stein' meaning 'stone'. It may also be associated with the Old High German 'kius' meaning 'slim'.

in_greek.name: Χειριστένη
in_greek.long_meaning: A Greek name derived from the word 'χειρ' meaning 'hand, labour' and 'istamai' meaning 'to stand, work'.

in_latin.long_meaning: A Latin name derived from 'caecus' meaning 'blind, hidden' and is associated with the Roman goddess Caecilia.
